column2: Curated place entries the gazetteers do not carry, with an explicit `kind`.
`kind` is the entity type. "ghetto" exists because a wartime ghetto is
neither a settlement nor an ordinary neighborhood: it is time-bounded and its
extent changed. Keeping it as its own kind means it can be resolved and
rolled up into its city WITHOUT being counted as a city, and lets the UI
label it honestly. Wikidata models these as P31=Q2583015 (Nazi ghetto).
Containment lives in settlement_parents.tsv, as it does for boroughs — the
parent_qid values there were taken from each entity's P131 on Wikidata, not
inferred.
`variants` is pipe-separated and matched after the resolver's usual
normalisation (niqqud stripped, final letters folded, whitespace collapsed),
so only genuinely distinct spellings need listing.
Columns: qid, kind, english, yiddish, variants, note
